rationale:
Issue #1181 ("Crash in patterns branch when switch statement's last case is empty") reports a crash with a concrete reproducer and diagnoses the root cause precisely: ChunkBuilder divides chunks at the hard split before an empty trailing case, so a rule that appears only in a constraint gets an index assigned before line splitting, breaking LineSplitter's null-index assumption. The minimized production patch attacks exactly that: Chunk gains preventDivide()/_canDivide default true, ChunkBuilder threads a _pendingPreventDivide flag through writeNewline and applies it when a hardened chunk is written (replacing the _calculateRuleRanges range-scan the issue itself describes as inadequate and too slow to fix by traversal), and SourceVisitor marks the switch-case and parameter-metadata newlines with preventDivide: true. This is the fix mechanism, not a drive-by refactor; the commit message and PR #1182 body describe it as the replacement solution for the same bug. Minimization already stripped the genuinely unrelated pieces present in the original commit: the whitespace-only reformat of DartFormatter._parse, the debug.dart variable-hoisting cleanup, and the pubspec.yaml analyzer version bump are absent from patches/minimized-production.patch. No test-only or config-only content remains in the production patch. The trigger is the unchanged upstream fixture from the same commit, test/regression/1100/1181.stmt, containing verbatim the switch statement from the issue body, exercised through the existing test/formatter_test.dart harness; it introduces no dependency on preventDivide() or any other API added by the fix. Strict evidence confirms build.both_versions passed, trigger.buggy_differential reproduced test/formatter_test.dart::regression 1181.stmt with the other two declared selectors passing on buggy as required, trigger.deterministic across 3 repetitions, trigger.fixed_clean, and full_suite.fixed_all_green with buggy full-suite failures limited to the reproduced trigger, both pre- and post-minimization. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#1181 is the sole allowed verified issue key.

Issue #1181 ('Crash in patterns branch when switch statement's last case is empty') gives the exact repro `switch (e) { case E.e1: break; case E.e2: }` and diagnoses the mechanism: because the last case is empty, the case-body rule does not reappear after the hard split, so ChunkBuilder divides between cases, a rule receives a non-null index via a constraint, and LineSplitter's null-index assumption is violated. The new fixture test/regression/1100/1181.stmt is byte-for-byte that repro, and strict evidence confirms it is the sole reproduced selector (test/formatter_test.dart::regression 1181.stmt fails on 35a5d9fc, passes on ac9113e2, deterministic over 3 repetitions, fixed full suite green). The minimized production patch is confined to the divide-decision mechanism the issue calls out as needing replacement: Chunk gains preventDivide() with _canDivide defaulting to true, ChunkBuilder tracks _pendingPreventDivide and marks hard-split chunks at write time instead of post-hoc _calculateRuleRanges scanning, and SourceVisitor threads preventDivide through the switch-case and parameter-metadata newline sites named in the issue. Removal of _calculateRuleRanges is the substitution of the faulty algorithm, not a drive-by refactor. Minimization correctly dropped the unrelated items present in the original commit: the dart_formatter.dart line-wrap reformat, the debug.dart variable relocation, and the pubspec.yaml analyzer ^5.5.0 to ^5.6.0 bump. The trigger is a project-native .stmt fixture consumed by the pre-existing formatter_test.dart harness and exercises only public formatting, not preventDivide() or the writeNewline preventDivide parameter introduced by the fix. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and the root cause matches the single allowed verified key.

risks: Two of the three declared trigger selectors (comments functions.unit, comments switch.stmt) do not reproduce the defect on the buggy revision; only regression 1181.stmt is differential, so the fixture-level granularity of the harness means those two add no fault-localization signal.
The buggy revision sits on the non-default 'patterns' feature branch (PR base_ref = patterns), so the defect and its fix are branch-local rather than on main at that time.

The fix replaces one whole mechanism (_calculateRuleRanges) with another (_pendingPreventDivide), a broad change touching all hardened-split division decisions; the single regression fixture plus the passing full suite is the only evidence that formatting behavior elsewhere is unchanged.

The minimized patch omits the pubspec.yaml analyzer ^5.5.0 -> ^5.6.0 bump present in the original commit; the strict build gate passed without it, but resolved dependency versions were not otherwise pinned in the supplied evidence.
